name: PartCrafter for Modly
description: Generate structured, separately editable 3D object parts or scene objects, with optional RMBG preprocessing, from one image using PartCrafter.
author: DrHepa

params_schema.label: Part Count Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Choose the part count yourself or ask Gemini to infer it from the image.

params_schema.label: Number of Parts
params_schema.tooltip: Number of separate object parts to generate. Upstream supports 1 through 16.

params_schema.label: Gemini Part Model
params_schema.tooltip: Gemini model used to suggest the part count. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY.

params_schema.label: Objaverse Style Transfer
params_schema.tooltip: Optionally ask Gemini to restyle a real-world photo as an Objaverse-like asset render before 3D generation.

params_schema.label: Gemini Style Model
params_schema.tooltip: Gemini image model used for optional style transfer. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY.

params_schema.label: Remove Background
params_schema.tooltip: Run upstream PartCrafter background removal after optional style transfer and part suggestion. Download the separate PartCrafter RMBG node first.

params_schema.label: Tokens per Part
params_schema.tooltip: Latent tokens generated for each part. Lower values reduce memory use; the upstream object default is 1024.

params_schema.label: Inference Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of denoising steps. The upstream default is 50.

params_schema.label: Guidance Scale
params_schema.tooltip: Image-conditioning guidance strength. The upstream default is 7.0.

params_schema.label: Maximum Expanded Coordinates
params_schema.tooltip: Safety limit for hierarchical mesh extraction. Use 0 to disable the limit, matching upstream semantics.

params_schema.label: Flash Decoder
params_schema.tooltip: Use PartCrafter's flash VAE decoder path. The upstream CLI default is disabled.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Random seed used by the PartCrafter pipeline. Negative seeds are accepted and remapped by PyTorch, matching upstream behavior.

params_schema.label: Turntable Rendering
params_schema.tooltip: Create the upstream 36-view color, normal, and input-comparison GIF/PNG turntables. Requires a working OpenGL offscreen context.

params_schema.label: Run Name
params_schema.tooltip: Optional sanitized name for the run directory and returned GLB, analogous to upstream --tag.

params_schema.label: Object Count Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Choose the scene object count yourself or ask Gemini to infer it from the image.

params_schema.label: Number of Objects
params_schema.tooltip: Number of separate scene objects to generate. Upstream supports 1 through 8.

params_schema.label: Gemini Count Model
params_schema.tooltip: Gemini model used to suggest the scene object count. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY.

params_schema.label: Objaverse Style Transfer
params_schema.tooltip: Optionally ask Gemini to restyle the source image before scene generation.

params_schema.label: Gemini Style Model
params_schema.tooltip: Gemini image model used for optional style transfer. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY.

params_schema.label: Tokens per Object
params_schema.tooltip: Latent tokens generated for each scene object. The upstream scene default is 2048.

params_schema.label: Inference Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of denoising steps. The upstream default is 50.

params_schema.label: Guidance Scale
params_schema.tooltip: Image-conditioning guidance strength. The upstream default is 7.0.

params_schema.label: Maximum Expanded Coordinates

params_schema.label: Flash Decoder
